🚨 CVE-2026-55181 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.4
Resumo:
Tugtainer is a self-hosted app for automating updates of Docker containers. Prior to version 1.30.3, Tugtainer's OIDC authentication can still be initiated even when OIDC_ENABLED=false. The /auth/oidc/enabled endpoint correctly reports that OIDC is disabled. However, a direct request to /auth/oidc/login still starts the OIDC login flow, returns HTTP 302, sets an oidc_state cookie, and redirects the user to the config...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-55181
 
🚨 CVE-2026-75786 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Unsanitized concatenation of the module parameter in the Grafana datasource endpoint allows authenticated blind SQL injection.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-75786

🚨 Critical FortiMail Zero-Day Flaw Exploited in Attacks Allows Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Writes
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), on Thursday, added a critical security flaw impacting Fortinet FortiMail to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, following reports of active exploitation. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-104286 (CVSS score: 9.8), allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files on the underlying system.
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/critical-fortimail-zero-day-flaw.html

In deployments using authentication, an attacker could induce a user to open a crafted Web UI link whose `aas` or `path` query parameter points to an attacker-controlled endpoint. The use...
